Why we are changing it

Per-seat pricing made sense when we started. It also taught our customers a bad habit: sharing one login between five people to keep the bill down. We could see it in the data. One account in three was used from more than four devices a day.

A shared login means nobody knows who approved an invoice, and that is exactly the problem Paperboat exists to solve.

What you will pay

  • Starter, 29 euros a month: up to 100 invoices a month, unlimited people.
  • Studio, 79 euros a month: up to 1,000 invoices, approvals and bank sync.
  • Company, 199 euros a month: unlimited invoices and a named support contact.

What happens to your plan

Nothing, unless the new price is lower. On 1 January we compare what you pay now with the new plan that fits your invoice volume and move you to whichever is cheaper. Nobody's bill goes up in 2027. You will get an email with your own numbers by 1 December.
